title: Furbo Barking Alert Cluster
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=furbo:event event=bark
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as bark_events by camera _time
| where bark_events>10
| sort - bark_events
description: Uses Furbo bark alerts telemetry to monitor hours where barking alerts arrived in tight clusters in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for stress or visitor patterns that keep triggering the dog camera, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Furbo bark alerts data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates hours where barking alerts arrived in tight clusters so you can spot stress or visitor patterns that keep triggering the dog camera before it becomes annoying.
